summary: Reproduced the mid-prefill cleanup assertion through free_kv_row_segments when touching request-row slices share an unaligned page. Coalesced only touching slices before the hybrid SWA dead/alive split, preserving gaps and the allocator's shared-page assertion. Added paged and real hybrid allocator regressions with interleaved gaps and repeated cleanup cycles.

tests.what_was_measured: Pre-fix regression reproduced AssertionError: segment at 5 shares a page with the one ending at 5. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/regression-before.txt

Post-fix paged allocator regression passed for touching slices, a later gapped slice, unique-page reference comparison, and two cleanup cycles. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/regression-after-cpu.txt

Real SWATokenToKVPoolAllocator restored both full and SWA capacities across an unaligned shared boundary page on two allocation/free cycles. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/regression-after-gpu.txt
Focused allocator and SWA suite: 49 passed, 38 subtests passed; existing shared-page rejection contract remained passing. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/focused-suite-final.txt

One visible AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; GPU float64 sum of squares 1..4096 was 22914881536, exactly matching the independent integer formula. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/gpu-evidence.txt
All applicable formatting, lint, spelling, syntax, registry, and repository policy hooks passed. Raw output: /job/raw/j-cfbcfd0e23b1/pre-commit.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 and HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 exposed one AMD Instinct MI350X. The hybrid allocator regression passed there, and the independent GPU numerical reference matched exactly.

remaining_limitations: The reported 8x NVIDIA B300 Kimi-K3/DSpark production workload was unavailable, so the full server abort replay and NVIDIA-specific execution were not run. Validation covers the exact failing Python cleanup path, a real hybrid SWA allocator on one MI350X, and the surrounding focused suite. No C++ or FlyDSL source changed; repository-environment.json records native as null.
